Data:Study.cracktrack.none.json.label: An Unfamiliar... Language?
Data:Study.cracktrack.none.json.desc: Uneven symbols in a complex pattern, veering off in all directions. The shapes are heavy with half-felt meaning... but I can't read it.

Data:Study.ericapaean.none.json.label: An Unfamiliar Language
Data:Study.ericapaean.none.json.desc: Elegant symbols - some teasingly like Greek letters. Sometimes when I trace them with my fingers, I think I hear distant, silvery bells... but I can't read it.

Data:Study.film.ability.hint.json.label: The Operations of the Eye
Data:Study.film.ability.hint.json.startdescription: 'To give only half your attention to a film - how? Why? Would you drink coffee without using your throat?' - Ilse Bischoff [Studying requires effort; you'll always need a suitable Soul card first.]

Data:Study.fucine.none.json.label: An Unfamiliar Language
Data:Study.fucine.none.json.desc: A half-familiar alphabet, like reversed Greek or upside-down Latin. My mouth feels oddly dry as I trace the letters with my fingers. I can't read it.

Data:Study.henavek.none.json.label: An Half-Familiar Language
Data:Study.henavek.none.json.desc: A familiar alphabet, an unfamiliar tongue. Some of the words sound Welsh, or Breton... it might be a very ancient form of Cornish.

Data:Study.hyksos.none.json.label: An Unfamiliar Language
Data:Study.hyksos.none.json.desc: Slyly curved, sharp-edged shapes. I can't read it, but every time I move to put the book down, my eyes are drawn back to those oddly delightful swoops and hooks...

Data:Study.journal.determination.first.h.label: A Determination?
Data:Study.journal.determination.first.h.startdescription:
When the Librarian of Hush House determines their answer to one of the great mysteries... the Hours themselves might pay attention.

[Making a Determination is the first step towards writing your own History. It will require no less than 20 of a Power aspect. This means suitably potent Soul, Memory, and Skill, as well as a carefully chosen ink.]

Data:Study.journal.determinations.more.h.label: A Determination?
Data:Study.journal.determinations.more.h.startdescription:
When the Librarian of Hush House determines their answer to one of the great mysteries... the Hours themselves might pay attention.

[To record a new History, you'll need an ink of power; one of the great secrets known as Numina, which usually dwell in the most hallowed books; and 25 points of a Power aspect. This is easier if you've made at least one, and preferably two, suitable Determinations.]

Data:Study.journal.general.hint.json.label: The Next Page?
Data:Study.journal.general.hint.json.startdescription: I could add something to this journal... if I could lay my hands on a suitable ink.

Data:Study.json.label: Study
Data:Study.json.desc: Something, usually a book, has been delved in detail.

Data:Study.killasimi.none.json.label: An Unfamiliar... Language?
Data:Study.killasimi.none.json.desc: A tight web of lines and angles that confounds the eye. Is it even a language? I certainly can't read it.

Data:Study.mandaic.none.json.label: An Unfamiliar Language
Data:Study.mandaic.none.json.desc: Robed and flowing shapes, rather as if the Aramaic script had taken up dancing. I can't read it.
